tagline: Gateways, routers and proxies between applications and LLM providers: one API, routing, caching, budgets and guardrails.
scope: It is about routing or governing LLM traffic between apps and providers, not an MCP gateway or a model host.
heroAlt: Animated isometric scene: request capsules travel from three app tiles into a switchboard console, where a dial turns to send each one to one of four model towers or to a cache drawer that pops open, while a budget bar fills.
